scripts.docs: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmndrs/docs/refs/heads/main/preview.sh | MDX=docs ICON=⚡ LOGO=https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-jolt/raw/main/docs/logo.png NEXT_PUBLIC_LIBNAME='React Three Jolt' NEXT_PUBLIC_LIBNAME_SHORT='r3/jolt' GITHUB=https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-jolt sh
scripts.docs:build: npx -y @pmndrs/docs@4 build docs docs/out --format website --libname "React Three Jolt" --libname-short "r3/jolt" --home-redirect "/getting-started/introduction" --icon "⚡" --logo "https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-jolt/raw/main/docs/logo.png" --github "https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-jolt" --discord "https://discord.gg/ZZjjNvJ"
scripts.changeset:version: yarn changeset version && yarn install --mode update-lockfile
scripts.changeset:publish: yarn build && yarn test && changeset publish
